caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers, primarily colored in varying shades of brown to denote the wood grain and texture. The furniture item consists of two main stacked sections: an upper chest segment with four horizontal rows of drawers (the top row divided into two smaller drawers), and a lower, slightly recessed segment with three side-by-side drawers. Each drawer is adorned with gold-colored ornamental handles and escutcheons at their centers. The chest is supported by eight turned, black legs connected by stretchers with decorative curves, and features an arched apron at the lower edge of the lower chest section. The background is plain and off-white, and there is no other object present in the image. The artist's signature, "HARRY EISMAN," appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Highboy
